subtitle: Enterprise Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric
executive_summary: Crestline Realty manages leasing in **Yardi Voyager**, finance in **Oracle E-Business Suite** and sales in **Salesforce**, with budgets and forecasts maintained in Excel on SharePoint. Month-end reporting today depends on manual consolidation across these systems and takes six to eight working days, which delays decisions on occupancy, collections and cash flow.

AutomatonsX proposes to implement an enterprise data platform on **Microsoft Fabric** that brings all four sources into a single governed OneLake foundation. The platform follows a Bronze, Silver and Gold medallion design, with certified semantic models feeding twelve Power BI dashboards for leasing, collections, sales pipeline and finance.

Governance is built in from the start. **Microsoft Purview** will catalog the estate, publish a business glossary, track lineage from source to report and apply sensitivity labels to tenant personal data. The engagement is planned over sixteen weeks and closes with knowledge transfer so Crestline's team can extend the platform with confidence.

objectives.text: Ingest Yardi Voyager, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and finance workbooks into OneLake on a reliable daily cadence with faster refresh during month end.
Build Bronze, Silver and Gold layers in Fabric with consistent naming, data quality checks and reconciliation against source totals.
Replace manual Excel consolidation with automated pipelines so finance can close and report within one to two days.
Deliver three certified semantic models and twelve Power BI dashboards with row-level security by community and business unit.
Classify and label tenant personal data in Purview and restrict access through Entra ID role-based controls.
Hand over runbooks, documentation and hands-on training so Crestline's team can operate and extend the platform.

scope_intro: The scope covers the end-to-end build of the Crestline data platform, from planning and environment setup through ingestion, modelling, governance, reporting and handover.

scope_sections.title: Project Initiation and Planning
items: Kick-off and discovery workshops with leasing, finance and sales stakeholders
Confirmation of KPIs, success criteria and the dashboard catalogue
Source system inventory and access readiness checklist
Detailed project plan, RAID log and communication plan

scope_sections.title: Infrastructure and Environment
items: Fabric workspaces for Dev, UAT and Prod in UAE North with deployment pipelines
Fabric capacity sizing recommendation (indicative, confirmed after discovery)
Entra ID security groups and workspace role design
Key Vault for source credentials, private connectivity to Oracle EBS through an on-premises data gateway
Git integration and CI/CD for notebooks, pipelines and semantic models

scope_sections.title: Data Integration
items: **Yardi Voyager**: scheduled extraction through the Yardi export API for about 120 tables
**Oracle EBS**: incremental extraction of GL, AP and AR using watermark columns for about 80 tables
**Salesforce**: ingestion of about 25 objects through the native Fabric connector
**SharePoint Excel**: governed file-drop for budget and forecast workbooks with schema validation
Metadata-driven ingestion framework with logging, retries and alerting

scope_sections.title: Data Lake and Modelling
items: Bronze layer holding raw copies of all source data in Delta format
Silver layer with cleansing, conformance and deduplication rules
Gold layer star schemas for Leasing, Collections, Sales and Finance
Reconciliation of Gold totals against source system reports

scope_sections.title: Governance and Compliance
items: Purview Data Map registration and scanning of the Fabric estate
Business glossary with up to 60 agreed terms
End-to-end lineage from source to Power BI report
Sensitivity labels and classification for tenant personal data

scope_sections.title: Power BI and Consumption
items: Three certified semantic models in Direct Lake mode
Twelve dashboards covering Leasing, Occupancy, Collections, Sales Pipeline, Finance P&L and Cash Flow
Row-level security by community and business unit
Mobile layouts for the leadership dashboards

scope_sections.title: Training and Knowledge Transfer
items: Two weeks of knowledge transfer sessions for IT and power users
Runbooks, architecture documentation and a support handover checklist

out_of_scope: Changes to source applications or their data models
Procurement of Fabric capacity, Power BI or Purview licenses
Reports beyond the twelve agreed dashboards, which will follow the change request process
assumptions: Crestline will provide timely access to Yardi, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and SharePoint along with service accounts
Business owners will be available for workshops, KPI sign off and UAT within agreed timelines
Dev, UAT and Prod workspaces will be available on Crestline's Fabric capacity
Source data volumes stay within the estimate shared during discovery
Any change in scope will be handled through a formal change request
logical_architecture: For Crestline, the data sources layer covers Yardi Voyager, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and finance workbooks. The ingestion layer uses Fabric Data Pipelines and an on-premises data gateway for Oracle, landing data into OneLake.

The lakehouse layer holds Bronze, Silver and Gold zones with Spark notebooks for transformation. Purview provides the governance and metadata layer, while Fabric monitoring and alerting cover orchestration and operations.
data_flow: **Source integration**: pipelines extract data from Yardi, Oracle EBS, Salesforce and SharePoint on schedule
**Landing in OneLake**: raw files and tables land in the landing zone with load metadata
**Bronze**: data is stored as Delta tables in its original form for audit and replay
**Silver**: notebooks cleanse, conform and deduplicate the data
**Gold**: star schemas are built for Leasing, Collections, Sales and Finance
**Consumption**: Direct Lake semantic models serve Power BI dashboards and mobile reports
**Governance**: Purview scans, classifies and traces lineage across every layer

architecture_layers.description: Operational systems for leasing, finance and sales plus finance workbooks
architecture_layers.components: Yardi Voyager, Oracle EBS, Salesforce, SharePoint

architecture_layers.description: Scheduled and incremental extraction with logging and retries
architecture_layers.components: Fabric Data Pipelines, On-prem Data Gateway
Direct Lake semantic models, Power BI

architecture_layers.description: Catalog, lineage, labelling and access control
architecture_layers.components: Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, Key Vault

timeline.intro: The engagement is planned over sixteen weeks in five stages. Indicative timelines will be confirmed in the project plan after discovery.

stages.activity: Discovery, KPI confirmation and environment setup
Ingestion framework and Bronze layer for all sources
Silver and Gold modelling with reconciliation
Semantic models and Power BI dashboards

risks.risk: Delayed access to Oracle EBS through the gateway
risks.mitigation: Raise network and gateway requests in week one and track them in the RAID log

risks.risk: KPI definitions differ across business units
risks.mitigation: Agree a signed KPI dictionary during discovery and record it in the Purview glossary

risks.risk: Yardi API limits slow down historical loads
risks.mitigation: Run the historical load in batches outside business hours

conclusion: We thank Crestline Realty for the opportunity to propose this engagement. AutomatonsX is confident that a governed Fabric platform will give Crestline faster month-end reporting and a single trusted view of leasing, sales and finance.
We look forward to discussing this proposal and are happy to clarify any part of it.

Confirm the Yardi API license tier and call limits
